title: FCA final notices
html:
Home News

Final notices

  • Northbridge Capital Ltd

    12 March 2024

    The FCA fined Northbridge Capital Ltd £4,650,000 for breaching SYSC 6.1.1R and SYSC 6.3.1R between January 2019 and March 2022.

  • Mr John Smith

    3 July 2023

    Prohibition order against Mr John Smith, a former director, for lack of integrity in breach of Principle 1 (APER).

  • Beta Bank plc

    1 February 2022

    Public censure of Beta Bank plc for failings under regulations 28(2) and 33 of the MLRs 2017.
